notes:
Summary:
- SMB customer (support SaaS) using hosted API for chat/FAQ augmentation. Self-serve signup, now in discovery after latency concerns.

Customer requirements / constraints:
- Workload: short chat turn (typical prompt 80-180 tokens), also light summarization for help articles.
- Latency target: p95 < 500ms for single-turn quick replies; p50 goal ~200-300ms.
- Throughput: bursty, ~10-40 rps during peak support hours. Cost sensitivity: moderate — wants best-effort low-cost model for most traffic with fallback to higher-quality models for long queries.
- Deployment: public cloud only (no VPC/on-prem at this time).
- Security: SSO (SAML) for admin portal and audit logs retention request (90 days).

Key perf issues reported:
- Significant region gap: us-east-1 and us-west-2 tests are OK (p50 180-320ms) but eu-west-1 runs show p50 600-1,200ms — customer assumed global parity.
- SDK defaults: customer saw long client-side timeouts causing perceived hangs; wants recommended timeouts and retry behavior.
- Prompt length: customers sometimes include full conversation + large doc snippets; increases latency and token cost.

What SE/AE recommended so far:
- Region guidance: recommend routing production traffic to nearest low-latency region (us-west-2 for their west-coast users, us-east-1 for east). For EU users, suggest deploying to eu-west-2 or eu-central-1 where our benchmarks show better p95. Explained cross-region traffic will add network tail latency.
- Timeout settings (SDK snippets provided in follow-up): short connect timeout (500-1000ms), request/response timeout ~15-30s for streaming chat; per-turn per-token streaming keeps perceived latency low. Also recommended client-side deadline of ~10-12s for quick-turn replies, with async fallback for long background jobs.
- Prompt length guidance: provide a short best-practices doc — encourage prompt condensation, context window management, prefix/KV caching for repeated system instructions, and structured context (metadata-only) instead of full document paste. Recommended chunking long docs and using embeddings for retrieval for long-context queries.
- Model routing: suggest default to a smaller low-latency model for fast replies with automatic fallback to medium model on heuristics (user asks for long generative responses). Discussed cost/perf tradeoffs.

Quotes / notable lines from calls:
- "We thought latency would be the same everywhere — the EU numbers surprised our ops team."
- "If we can get reliable 300ms responses most of the time, we can keep this in free-tier flows; otherwise we need to gate behind premium plans."

Open items / POC plan:
1) Run hands-on POC in us-west-2 (SE-led) to reproduce low-latency config and provide logs/trace.
2) Provide small code snippets: SDK timeout settings, retry policy, streaming example, and prompt truncation helpers.
3) Create a short one-pager "Latency checklist for SignalPond" (region selection, timeouts, prompt trimming rules).
4) If EU users remain high-latency, propose multi-region routing with sticky affinity + cost estimate.

Next call planned 2026-03-17: review POC results and decide if move to demo or evaluation.
